question: Mendel proposed the law of independent assortment on the basis of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**dihybrid crosses**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mendel proposed the law of independent assortment based on his experiments with **dihybrid crosses**.
 
• In his experiments, Mendel crossed plants that differed in two traits and observed the inheritance patterns of these traits in the offspring.
 
• The results led to the conclusion that the alleles of different genes assort independently
